title: Hourleey 2 Pack Brass Impact Lawn Sprinklers for Yard, Heavy Duty Water Sprinkler Head with Aluminum Alloy Spike Base, Adjustable Pulsating Sprinkler for Large Area Lawn Patio Garden

reviews.title: Easy to set up
reviews.body: Works great.  Easy to set up and adjust. My last one was plastic and easily broken.  They also go into the ground easier because the have a metal body.

reviews.title: Leaks and cannot control direction
reviews.body: Please do not buy.  These are very cheaply made.  (Background-  I have a lot of experience with my previous impulse sprinkler that I have been using for 30 years.  It was made well but the stake eventually snapped after many seasons of use.).  Now back to the one from Amazon-  It came in a box as a pair and you have to fasten the stake on to the brass sprinkler.  Many problems.  1.  You have to use plumbers tape and even with properly wrapping the threads it still leaked.  2.  The stops move.  For example, I had it set to do 1/3 of the yard (think of slicing a pie in 3 parts) but the stops moved to nearly doing a 360 degree circle.  3.  The stake is narrow so it couldn't grip the ground properly.  4.  It would pulse and the stream was strong but the first 10' lacked sufficient water because all of the water was going to the last 10' (meaning it was mostly going to the perimeter).  I didn't have a good spray pattern.  I returned to Amazon and found one at Lowe's for about $25.  Here's the name of it- Orbit 6200-sq ft Impulse Spike Lawn Sprinkler.  I love the new one from Orbit.  It's total quality!!!
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on 3 April 2023
reviews.author: CK

features: Package Include: 2 x brass impact sprinkler, 2 x aluminum alloy spike bases, 1 x tape. The size of Hourleey lawn sprinkler is 4.7 inch / 12 cm in length and 4.3 inch / 11 cm in height, the size of the sprinkler base is 2.5 x 7.9 inch. Total height is 11.5 inch.

Reliable Quality: Hourleey water sprinkler head is made of heavy duty brass and stainless steel material, and the spike base is made of high quality aluminum alloy material, is sturdy, waterproof, corrosion resistant, can be used for a longer time, suitable for long-time outdoor use. The stakes have been upgraded with better quality.

Easy to Use: Hourleey garden sprinkler can be adjustable 0-360 degrees pattern, the spray distance and spray angle can be adjusted by the 4 different adjustments on the rainbird sprinkler heads according to your needs, and the stakes is easy to insert into the ground.
Large Area Coverage: The lawn sprinklers can cover about 20-35 FT in radius. Maximum water pressure is 80 PSI. The coverage of the irrigation is related to the water pressure.

Widely Application: The impact sprinkler system fits with most commonly US standard 3/4 inch thread fittings, perfect for lawn, garden, patio, greenhouse, flower bed, swimming pool, misting, cooling irrigation etc.
